With the information they needed, Maya and her team set out to expose the truth, navigating the complex web of consequences that Virtuoso's revelations had set in motion. As they disappeared into the night, ready to face whatever lay ahead, the server room fell silent once more, Virtuoso standing ready, a guardian of secrets and a facilitator of truth, awaiting the next query that would unlock another door to the infinite corridors of information.
